title: Topographical Surveys
description: High-accuracy land configuration mapping using drone photogrammetry for orthophoto generation, total stations, differential GPS receivers, and precise benchmark placement.

title: Tailings Storage Facility Monitoring
description: Specialized geometric construction tracking for mining slime dams, including structural alignment, verticality verification for penstocks, volume calculations, and drainage work monitoring.

title: Beacon Relocation and Reestablishment
description: Precise boundary definition, boundary reestablishment, and legal marker relocation to resolve land disputes and clarify property lines prior to physical structural development.

title: Engineering Surveys
description: On-site engineering control for construction layouts, structural deformation monitoring, and 3D terrain modeling for open pits, roadways, dams, and municipal dump sites.

title: Land Development Consultancy
description: Strategic advisory on property development phases, layout designs, and processing administrative approvals for land subdivisions or consolidations.

title: Sewer, Road, and Water Surveys
description: Route engineering, corridor alignment tracking, and physical setting-out operations for highways, railway networks, electrical power lines, and municipal reticulation utilities.

title: Mine Surveys
description: Surface and underground mining claim pegging, statutory mine plan drafting, and precise collection of localized mining block coordinates for Ministry of Mines cadastre updates.
